ONE-TRUTH-1 made 19 copies machine-written and machine-checked. That was the wrong shape: a
generated copy is still a copy, it still has to be kept in step, and a reader who finds one has
no way to know whether it is the truth or a stale rendering of it. ONE-TRUTH-2 (the owner's
order) deleted all 19. Where a document's argument needed the reader to know a fingerprint
EXISTS, it now points here; where it did not, the mention was removed.
WHERE A CURRENT VALUE MAY STILL APPEAR, and nowhere else:
- this file
- docs/TAGS.md — the tag register. A tag's hash is what it was when the tag was cut.
- reports/ — the lab journal. Append-only by rule: a report records what was true on the day
it was written and must never be rewritten. Listed as a PREFIX rather than 112 filenames,
which is a decision: enumerating them would be noise that nobody would maintain, and the
append-only rule already makes every one of them history by construction.
TO RE-MINT: run the role's `reproduce` command, put the new value here, and commit. There is
nothing else to update — that is the point.
WHICH DOCUMENT OWNS WHAT, resolved because four of them implied they owned this:
- THIS FILE owns the CURRENT VALUES. Nothing else does.
- docs/SIM.md owns the LINEAGE — which change moved which value to which. Its head points here.
- reports/parity/REBASELINE.md owns WHAT MOVED each one, and now carries no values.
- docs/SHIP-CEREMONY.md owns the PROCEDURE for minting.

WHAT MOVED IS DRAWING AND NOTHING ELSE: the minimap gains a start mark, a finish mark, and a wash over the stretch behind the finish, all inside the same canvas the sampler hashes. THE MARKS ARE BARS ACROSS THE BAND at getPosition(t, +-0.5) — the SAME segment the world finish gate spans, since drawOpenTrackFinishLine extrudes getPosition(ft, 0) by openTrackHW = trackWidthPx / 2 = the width getPosition offsets by — so the mark and the line the racers cross cannot drift apart by construction rather than by agreement. Solid green starts, a black/white checker finishes, and where the two coincide (every closed track, where the gate and the front start row both sit at t 0) ONE mark carries both: the checker on a green plate. SIZES WERE CHOSEN AGAINST A MEASUREMENT, NOT A GUESS: the bar is 12-22 panel px on the ten shipped tracks and its ends land within 1.5 panel px of the drawn band edge, both measured across all ten; an earlier reading assumed about 50 px and would have drawn a blob on half the game. THE UNRACED TAIL IS BUILT FROM THE MARKS OWN SOURCE, which is the whole reason its seam lands on the checker: driving the shipped renderMinimap through a recording context on all ten tracks at four finish positions gives SEAM 0.000000 panel px, every open track, every finish. The alternative — the bands own index-paired getEdgePoints — was rejected with numbers: those two parameterisations disagree by up to 502 world px on luger-hill, an along-track offset that would have put the seam visibly off the mark. The tails side boundary is a different question and is NOT zero: it washes a band drawn from the other source, so it sits up to 1.74 panel px off that bands outline, below the width of the cyan edge that covers it. THE WASH IS DRAWN BEFORE THE EDGE OUTLINES so the cyan edge still runs through it — without that the tail reads as the track ends here, which is the opposite of true. NO CONFIG KEY WAS ADDED and the minimap still reads nothing but the shape it is handed; the two t values come in as parameters.
